is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (Title: 'CRISPR/Cas9 modified An. gambiae carrying kdr mutation L1014F...').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) mutation (Abstract: '...study the effect of the classical kdr mutation L1014F (L995F based on An. gambiae numbering)...').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The study reports genotype frequencies for the laboratory-generated lines (Page 3: 'A positive transformation event was found in progeny of one G0 female at a frequency of 18% (Table A in S1 Text) and verified through sequencing.').

african_field_population.evidence: The study is conducted entirely on laboratory-reared and genome-edited mosquito strains using the Kisumu background (Page 3: 'Embryos of the insecticide susceptible Kisumu strain were injected with a CRISPR/Donor plasmid mix...'). No field-collected mosquitoes from Africa were genotyped or tested.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing the creation and characterization of genome-modified mosquito lines.

sub_country_location.evidence: Not applicable as this is a laboratory study using the Kisumu strain.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Not applicable as this is a laboratory study; no field collection dates are provided.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary study describing the creation of new transgenic lines using CRISPR/Cas9.

supplement.evidence: The lack of field population data is evident from the main text; supplementary files (S1 Text, S1 Data) describe laboratory results and would not change the eligibility status.

assessment.summary: This study uses CRISPR/Cas9 to introduce the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) mutation into the susceptible Anopheles gambiae Kisumu laboratory strain to functionally validate its contribution to insecticide resistance. It also examines the combined effect of this mutation with Gste2 overexpression. While the paper provides detailed genotype-phenotype data and bioassay results, it is ineligible because it does not study field-collected mosquitoes from Africa, relying solely on laboratory-generated transgenic lines.
exclusion_reasons: The study uses laboratory-generated transgenic lines based on the Kisumu strain and does not report data from African field populations.
